rationale: Independent reading: EO 10085 (14 FR 6617) only rewrites sec. 1(d) of EO 10011. Held EO 10903 (26 FR 217) sec. 5(a) item 3 revokes 'Executive Order No. 10085 of October 28, 1949', subject to 5(b); 5(b) preserves existing rules, regulations and actions taken under the revoked provisions until superseded, which is a savings clause for derivative acts, not continued operation of the order. EO 10187 also restated 1(d) 'as amended by EO 10085' earlier. I agree: NO.
